name: Propose a Skill / 提议一个 Skill

title: "[Skill] "

assignees: ""
---

English or Chinese is welcome. / 中英文都可以。

## What work should this Skill do? / 要完成什么工作？

Describe the repeated task and who would use it.

## What does the user provide? / 用户提供什么？

List the inputs, scope, and dependencies. Use invented examples, not real account or client data.

## What should come back? / 应交付什么？

Describe the files or result, how to check it, and what an unfinished result means.

## Do you have a working version? / 是否已有实现？

Idea only, draft script, or tested Skill? Link public code if available.
State what you actually tested and any known limits.

## What would you like to contribute? / 你希望参与哪部分？

Implementation, tests, documentation, translation, feedback, or discussion.
